question: Under the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) alternatives consultant RFP, what must the consultant's quarterly performance report include at a minimum?
expected_facts: (i) market overview and outlook; (ii) allocation breakdown by geography, strategy and industry; (iii) update on each fund; (iv) listing of each fund by strategy; (v) date of commitment to each fund; (vi) commitment amount to each fund; (vii) drawdown amounts by fund; (viii) outstanding commitment by fund; (ix) distribution amounts by fund; (x) fund net asset values; (xi) IRR and multiples of each fund; (xii) items vi-xi aggregated for the core private equity portfolio, the specialized portfolio and the total portfolio.
acceptance: Accept compact grouping of per-fund cash-flow/commitment measures if each required type is represented, including IRR/multiples and aggregation. Do not import the separate monthly-report requirements.
